title: Hyperbolicity of Fermat-type curves and their complements
summary: In this paper, by using the generalized Borel theorems in $\mathbb{CP}^2$, we show the hyperbolicity of Fermat type curves and their complement in $\mathbb{CP}^2$. This improves Noguchi-Shirosaki's and Demailly-El Goul's degree bounds.
